statements.scope: Compared full finite-order Hecke family over Q(sqrt(-3)), all Dirichlet characters, strict Re(s)>7/8, all heights and conductors, principal pole allowed.
Compared absolute polylog bound (A=32 in proof), every delta>0 power bound, deterministic square-root algorithm.
Full hypotheses and conclusion read; uniform omega/sigma versus target-dependent constants, excluded sets, H, and lower thresholds distinguished.
Internal first-stage input, not the separate 49-page manuscript.
Moment conditions, masks, row families, prime slots, mesh and target quantifiers compared; not full independent verification of the inductions.
Order of real choices before the target, finite internal orders before external height/tails, positive common savings read.

proofPassages.scope: Complete continuation argument, including small-Z decay, Fourier identification and supremum contradiction.
Input reflection statement and fixed theta formulas; quadratic sieve application; balanced additive and low bound; sextic sieve statement and initial paired-character construction.
Late height choice, balanced high bound and first-stage conclusion, full quadratic transfer, compensated geometry.
Fixed-ray prime normalizer; compensated low proof; quotient-free local correction; principal normalization and high exponent.
Moment statements, masked Poisson identity and induction entry/termination, equal-scale-product centering, exceptional-row division and final mesh/height order, application of moments to row counts.
Small/large rows, endpoint certificate argument, frequency coverage and final order of choices, including subtraction of Delta.
All conclusions and direct external input statements compared.

dependencies.checking: Explicit theta/cusp formulas and cited use checked; no GRH-conditional prime asymptotic used.

Nonresidue search is sole random step; remainder deterministic polynomial-time.
